pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: Whole roof is in deep shadow (navy) with a dense tree canopy over the south half; no ridge or hip lines visible. Ridge direction E-W is a guess from the plan shape only.

notes: Unreadable roof: house sits in the shadow of a large tree to its south and the canopy covers the south half. Single hip rectangle from the trace with the east 68 px strip (bright concrete and a straight fence shadow) excluded; the true east eave may be anywhere between x=700 and 750. Confidence low.
